overall_reason: The visitor mode is Operate/Read (an AI tool directory and stack picker); its claims are counts of its own directory and third-party prices, with no testimonials, logos or result figures, and the two problems are small: the tool count is stated two ways and the three footer social icons link to '#'; the 'Made in Bolt' badge is an honest builder mark (INT-129).

score.reason: T-PROOF-SOURCE and T-PROOF-SWAP pass because the page shows no proof to invent; T-FIGURE-AUDIT finds the count given as both '20+' and '20' (INT-011, Reflex) and T-PROMISE-LINK finds three dead social links (INT-016, Reflex).

findings.where: hero trust row (first screen) and 'Featured tools' intro, 1440; tiles/1440-00.png and tiles/1440-02.png
findings.evidence: The hero row says '20+ curated tools' (claims table figure, flags 'open-ended (+)' and 'round', first_screen). The 'Featured tools' intro two screens later says 'A few of the 20 tools in our directory.' One count appears with two values. Draft INT-151 (one fact, one value) names this.
findings.before: "20+ curated tools" in the hero and "A few of the 20 tools in our directory" below
findings.after: State the exact count in both places ('20 curated tools'), or drop the number from the hero row.
findings.why: The '+' makes the hero claim larger than the directory's own count; a visitor who reads both lines learns the hero number is padding.

findings.evidence: The claims table's dead_links block lists the Twitter, GitHub and LinkedIn icon links in the footer 'Connect' column, each with href '#'. On the tile they render as three icon buttons under 'Connect' with nothing to show they are placeholders. Draft INT-146 says a link with no known URL must not point at '#'.
findings.before: Three 'Connect' icons (Twitter, GitHub, LinkedIn) linking to '#'
findings.after: Link the real profiles, or remove the 'Connect' column.
findings.why: The icons claim a public presence that a visitor can check; clicking them goes nowhere, which suggests the accounts do not exist.

strengths: Each featured tool card states its plan and price beside the action ('Free / ₹1,650 mo Plus', 'Free / ₹415 mo Starter'), so no cost is hidden on this page.
The page shows no testimonials, logo walls, ratings or user counts, so it makes no proof claims it would need to back.
The 'Add to compare' buttons made no request and claimed no success they did not show.
not_investigated: authenticity against outside sources: the lens does not browse, so any claim only the web could settle is not verified
checkout, signup and cancellation flows beyond the captured page
countdown or counter behaviour on reload: the capture does not reload to compare
the third-party prices could not be checked; 'Canva ₹4,000 mo Pro' in particular may be an annual price shown as monthly, but only the web could settle it
'Updated for 2026' in the hero row carries no date of the last update and could not be checked
T-URGENCY-REAL and T-DEFAULT-STATE: the page has no urgency, counts or choices
T-DECLINE-READ: no dialog or decline option was captured
